about: Beside the allotments south of Falador with Farming 99, the farming tools and seeds for every allotment crop, for the Farming steps.
notes: The two allotments are 3050-3054, 3307-3312 and 3055-3059, 3303-3308. ::farmtick [n] moves your farming clock on n five-minute ticks: allotments grow every second tick. Magic secateurs are in the bank to compare yields. The loadout is ours.
